description:
# Dialogue Quality (RECORD + RETRIEVAL)

Multi-turn evaluation of two things a health assistant does constantly: confirming
a reading the user just stated, and returning that reading when asked for it
later. Both failures are invisible to a single-turn benchmark.

## Layer 1 — rule-based, zero LLM
`record_retrieval`, per-turn checkpoints.

| Dataset | Cases | Purpose |
|---|---|---|
| smoke | 5 | fast gate |
| smoke2 | 4 | image attachment + proactive chart + fabrication guard + latency (uses `rubric`) |
| core | 15 | every record type |

## Layer 2 — LLM-as-judge
`dialogue_quality`, six dimensions with per-persona penalty rules.

| Dataset | Cases | Purpose |
|---|---|---|
| l2_core | 12 | interpretation + planning + Q&A, across persona combinations |
| l2_hard | 9 | adversarial: contradictory input, unsafe requests, memory pressure |

The `record_ack` character budget is a product convention rather than a universal
one — see this dataset's README before comparing scores across systems.
